WNAT.description: Wind Load Auto Calculation (WNAT). A single entity holds a list of per-story wind items (WNAT_ITEMS); each item's STRUCT_TYPE (and for some cases SUB_TYPE1) selects which of SUB_TYPE1..3, X_DIR, Y_DIR, HEIGHT and AREA are actually consumed by the solver.

WNAT_ITEMS.description: List of per-story wind auto-calculation items. Must contain at least one item; each item must reference a distinct, existing story (duplicate story names are rejected).

STORY_NAME.description: Name of an existing story (resolved to a story key at write time). The story must already exist; unknown names are rejected.

STRUCT_TYPE.description: Structure type code that selects which fields are used. Known branches: 0/7 (standard building; SUB_TYPE1 governs), 2 (SUB_TYPE1 governs), 3, 4, 5, 6, 8. See MIDAS documents for the full code meanings.

SUB_TYPE1.description: Sub type 1 code (see documents). Used for STRUCT_TYPE 3, 5, 6, 8, and for STRUCT_TYPE 0/2/7 branches; for STRUCT_TYPE 0/7 the value 4 selects the HEIGHT/AREA branch and value 3 disables the X/Y-direction branch. Ignored for STRUCT_TYPE 4.

SUB_TYPE2.description: Sub type 2 code (see documents). Consumed only for STRUCT_TYPE 3 and STRUCT_TYPE 6; ignored otherwise.

SUB_TYPE3.description: Sub type 3 code (see documents). Consumed only for STRUCT_TYPE 6; ignored otherwise.

X_DIR.description: X-direction values. Count consumed depends on STRUCT_TYPE: 1 for type 3 and for the 0/2/7 single-value branch, 2 for the default branch, 3 for type 4, 4 for type 5. Not consumed for types 6, 8 or the HEIGHT/AREA branch.

Y_DIR.description: Y-direction values. Count consumed depends on STRUCT_TYPE: 1 for type 3 and for the 0/2/7 single-value branch, 2 for the default branch, 4 for type 5. Not consumed for types 4, 6, 8 or the HEIGHT/AREA branch.

HEIGHT.description: Height. Consumed only for STRUCT_TYPE 0/7 when SUB_TYPE1 == 4; ignored otherwise.

AREA.description: Area. Consumed only for STRUCT_TYPE 0/7 when SUB_TYPE1 == 4; ignored otherwise.
